{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.10

|arg= local


|descr= Get the current optics mode of the optics in the turret occupied by the specified unit. The alternative syntax allows a vehicle and turret path to be specified without needing a unit. Optic modes refer to the different fields of view (FOV) or zoom levels of an optic.

|gr1= Turrets

|s1= [[getTurretOpticsMode]] obj

|p1= obj: [[Object]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|s2= obj [[getTurretOpticsMode]] turretPath

|p21= obj: [[Object]]

|p22= turretPath: [[Turret Path]]

|r2= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>getTurretOpticsMode player;</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>myTank getTurretOpticsMode [-1];</sqf>

|x3= <sqf>myAircraft getTurretOpticsMode [0, 0];</sqf>

|seealso= [[setTurretOpticsMode]] [[turretOwner]] [[getPilotCameraOpticsMode]] [[setPilotCameraOpticsMode]]
}}
